implementation_boundary: This file defines cross-module field ownership and current seams. A Rust type proves serialization shape only; per-field status records whether the application produces, persists, and enforces it. CLI interface, worker runtime, provider declaration, and model-instance evidence are distinct.

operation_request.status: proposed; current CLI command builders are not uniformly adapted to this DTO

fields.contract_version: Required contract major/minor generation; incompatible changes require a new version.
fields.operation: Canonical operation_ref selected by the user or caller.
fields.inputs[]: Only values and facts relevant to this operation, with source and optional source-scoped revision.
fields.parameters: Operation-specific open JSON object; owner module defines its schema.

rules: The plan is for one selected operation; unrelated missing project fields do not block it.
The DTO preserves ready, needs_input, conditional, unsupported, and unknown as distinct states.
ready structurally requires all required facts, inputs, and capabilities to be available.

Current ApplicationUiServices blocks needs_input and unsupported but does not block required conditional or unknown. Interactive training confirmation permits start for both without resolving unknown evidence; unknown must fail closed, while conditional may proceed only after its stated condition is resolved and revalidated.
Actions are suggestions with availability and reason; they do not execute automatically.
Plans are point-in-time and do not reserve source/config/runtime state. Recompute before mutation or execution.

limitations: success/error is not an operation readiness result.
data schemas vary by operation and are not yet normalized into typed DTOs.
operation currently mixes Rust report labels and Python worker operation names.

diagnostic.status: legacy code/message/hint wire shape implemented; optional DiagnosticDetails type exists, producer coverage partial
diagnostic.rule: Recovery actions are advice, not commands. Availability/reason/confirmation are required before presentation; executing one requires explicit selection and fresh validation. Legacy hint remains display-only.

identity_and_revision.status: partial DTO primitives exist (InputSource); cross-domain identity and consistent revision production remain proposed
rules: A revision is meaningful only for its named source/provider; it is not globally comparable.
Invocation identity is scoped to one probe/forward/batch. Dynamic call indices are not persistent edit targets.
Alias paths identify references to an instance; they do not duplicate module parameter ownership.
Sensitive input values are redacted from diagnostics, logs, and acceptance evidence.

legacy_mapping.module_instance_id: worker-generated instance id when available; CLI rows may currently use instance_id
legacy_mapping.source_revision: source/manifest hashes where current operations expose them

state_and_event.status: partial: run progress/event records and artifact references exist in operation-specific forms; no universal OperationEvent/ArtifactRef DTO
rules: Every state category uses preserved/reset/migrated/not_applicable/unknown; omission is not equivalent to preserved.
Event sequence is monotonic within one operation id; event absence is not proof that work did not occur.
Artifact references carry owner and integrity identity; a path string alone is not proof of a valid artifact.

core.responsibility: Operation planning/execution seams, protocol version, diagnostics and cross-module adapters.
must_not_claim: an operation is executable because its CLI command exists
a missing event means no work occurred
core.status: Report v1, worker protocol/capability DTO, operation/readiness DTOs and selected application planning implemented; universal plan enforcement and typed report adapters remain incomplete

model.responsibility: Native model construction/discovery, input/output ports, module identity, forward evidence and contract checks.
provides: declared input/output and per-module invocation contract evidence
ephemeral local invocation replay and metadata-only evidence reuse
model.status: native worker probe and optional JSON port contracts implemented; normalized Rust DTO remains planned

edit.responsibility: Layer/source/variant/assembly plan, candidate validation, commit history, shared-instance policy and state migration.
edit.status: partial: operation-specific preview/commit and source/variant transaction flows exist; unified cross-target EditPlanContract/StateImpact is not the wire contract

train.responsibility: Training modes, user steps/loops, budget, named optimizers, evaluation and resumable state.
train.status: implemented with mode-specific checkpoint, metric and user-state limits; unified typed event/artifact DTO remains proposed

run.responsibility: Immutable run inputs, activity ownership, supervision, cancellation, events, artifacts and query.
run.status: implemented_for_registered_run_artifacts; undeclared copies and non-run consumers remain outside the resolver

artifact_manifest.format: artifacts.json schema_version=2; v1 is readable but cannot authorize release
artifact_manifest.declaration: external-loop context.register_artifact(id, files, owner, references, consumes, complete, kind)
artifact_manifest.verification: Rust verifies declared files and SHA-256; project cleanup resolves typed {run_id, artifact_id} consumers across complete run manifests and fails closed on active, incomplete, legacy, malformed, or dangling identities.
artifact_manifest.completion: producer complete=true is effective only when the enclosing run completed successfully; invalid declarations produce incomplete state with all unregistered files protected
artifact_manifest.cleanup: Custom multi-file checkpoint release uses a fixed plan and revalidates project consumers, ownership, files, hashes, run state, and hard links.

run.cleanup: m-model runs clean accepts --artifact <artifact-id> during dry-run; complete reference-free custom checkpoint sets release as one fixed-plan group after member-by-member identity/hash checks.

extension.responsibility: Versioned component descriptions, dependency closure, API compatibility, conformance and lifecycle.
extension.status: local manifest discovery, dependency resolution, conformance and lifecycle operations implemented; local declarations are not model-instance proof

data.responsibility: Task-specific batch adaptation, deterministic sampling, transform order and preview request/result.
data.status: local class-folder indexing, content/split fingerprints, deterministic per-class split/subset selection, explicit exclusions, selected-image verification, ordered built-in/custom transforms and per-step port checks, real Dataset/batch preview sampling, signed PNG/HTML/summary/custom-renderer artifacts, stable-sample cache and generation-safe publication implemented; generic model_probe Dataset adapters remain separate

environment.responsibility: Python/runtime identity, lock/setup/drift, offline package closure and portability/export facts.
environment.status: environment lock/check/setup and same-ABI wheelhouse archive/check/replay are implemented; OS/driver/data portability remains outside the contract

cli.responsibility: Human terminal interaction, action selection, forms, navigation, waiting and machine output.
cli.status: CLI pages and selected application service planning are implemented; not every command consumes OperationPlan and typed event/artifact service contracts remain partial

acceptance.responsibility: Requirements-to-evidence mapping, failure recovery, integration, release and value validation.

native_callable_protocols.status: implemented_current_convention; stable only for the named entrypoint kind
rules: Model factory: module:callable -> torch.nn.Module; accepts explicit declared factory parameters.
Batch factory: module:callable -> a native value or {args: [...], kwargs: {...}} envelope; explicit binding is required when ambiguous.
Managed step: training_step(model, batch, context, **parameters) -> declared loss/result mapping.
External loop: run_loop(model, context, **parameters); owns its internal data and update logic within the declared budget/stop contract.
A plain Python callable is sufficient for one-off use; component manifests and SDK classes are optional adoption layers.
native_callable_protocols.compatibility: Changing positional meaning, batch envelope semantics or result interpretation requires an explicit protocol version or adapter; unknown optional fields remain preservable.

file_ownership_and_handoff.rule: CORE owns migration of shared entry files. Domain modules own their assigned post-migration directories. Cross-module shared-file changes are sent as integration_patch to the coordinator; no parallel edits to the same shared file.
file_ownership_and_handoff.contract_change: The named contract owner proposes a versioned change, lists producer/consumer impact, updates schemas and positive/negative examples, and requests integration before any consumer assumes it.

implemented: Report envelope v1 and worker protocol/API v1 compatibility checks
Static worker operation-to-required-feature registry and doctor runtime capability descriptors
CLI interface catalog v1 metadata response
OperationPlan/Readiness/InputSource DTOs and input-only planning for selected application commands
Selected-run progress/cancellation and preview async lifecycle with operation-specific semantics
Operation-specific preview/guarded commit, request IDs, stale-input revision checks and model-evidence cache identity checks
partial: ApplicationUiServices rejects required missing inputs and explicitly unsupported capabilities; required unknown/conditional readiness is not yet blocked there
Legacy diagnostic producers mostly emit code/message/hint; optional structured recovery details are not populated uniformly
Runtime capability cache invalidation and model/preview cache invalidation are source-specific, not one universal stale protocol
Typed operation identity, event and artifact DTOs are not consumed across all modules
proposed: Universal lightweight per-operation query covering all CLI actions
Global stale-evidence marker and invalidation bus
Cross-domain typed event/artifact handoff and complete module ownership DTOs
current_vs_proposed.explicit_non_claim: A DTO, catalog entry, route, successful legacy Report, or declared provider capability does not prove a selected model instance supports an operation. No homepage readiness query may execute user code or mutate/install/download.
